_why: DESIGN: relies on a scenario shade preset to state drain + target_lantern_id (a draining shade is always > 6 m from the player, so it cannot be pulsed naturally). Pulse centre (4, 0.8, 0): S1 (1,1,0) sqrt(9 + 0.04) = 3.007 <= 5, S2 (7,1,0) same. S1 was draining just before: +15; S2 is a normal wander shade: +5 -> score 20 (ticket: 'tong +5 moi con; tong +15 neu ngay truoc do dang drain'). carried 6 - 3 = 3. Both stunned 120 ticks and pushed 4 m away from the player along X: S1 1 - 4 = -3.0, S2 7 + 4 = 11.0 by tick 15, still there at tick 20; no hit.
